entities.name: Mobile Initiated Connection Only Mode
entities.description: A mode where UE can deactivate AS layer and only initiate connections, requested during registration procedure and activated when specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE can request MICO mode and network can accept it by providing MICO indication.

entities.name: MICO Indication IE
entities.description: Information element used by network to indicate acceptance of MICO mode, may contain 'all PLMN registration area allocated' and 'strictly periodic registration timer supported' indications.

entities.name: Timer T3324
entities.description: Active timer that controls UE reachability period after entering 5GMM-IDLE mode when MICO mode with active time is used.

entities.name: Timer T3512
entities.description: Periodic registration timer that continues running during MICO mode and is used for strictly periodic monitoring.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: State entered by UE when activating MICO mode, indicating AS layer is deactivated.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE
entities.description: State where UE enters before starting T3324 timer and potentially activating MICO mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: State that stops T3324 timer and prevents MICO mode activation.

entities.name: Emergency PDU Session
entities.description: Condition that prevents MICO mode request and disables active MICO mode when established.

entities.name: Strictly Periodic Monitoring Timer
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when 'strictly periodic registration timer supported' is indicated, using T3512 value.

relations.description: MICO mode is requested and negotiated during registration procedure
Network includes MICO indication IE when accepting MICO mode during registration
UE enters 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state when activating MICO mode
UE starts T3324 timer after entering 5GMM-IDLE mode when active time value is received
UE stops T3324 timer when entering 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
Emergency PDU session establishment prevents MICO mode request and disables active MICO mode
AMF starts strictly periodic monitoring timer when 'strictly periodic registration timer supported' is indicated in MICO indication IE
UE stops T3512 timer when emergency PDU session is established and MICO mode is disabled
